warnings: T = 1123 K is outside the calibration range (773.15 to 1073.15 K (500-800 C, extrapolated above)) of Ganguly & Tazzoli (1994)

Ganguly & Tazzoli (1994) state the law only for fO2 from the iron-wustite (IW) buffer to 0.8 log units above IW; the fO2 window is not checked by Diffusor for this entry (the law has no fO2 term), so make sure the crystal's fO2 lies in it or accept the extrapolation.
1-D modelling can be biased by 3-D geometry and section orientation; it is not a universal upper bound on time (Shea et al. 2015, Krimer & Costa 2017).
